subject: MATHEMATICS
title: Equal Groups and Facts
objective: Model multiplication with equal groups and arrays.
introduction: Milo has 3 baskets with 4 mangoes each! Help him find the total with multiplication.

vocabulary.definition: Groups that have the same number of things.
Adding the same number again and again.
Objects arranged in equal rows and columns.

activities.instruction: Watch how 3 groups of 4 makes 12 mangoes.
activities.content: Multiplication represents equal groups; 3 groups of 4 has 12 objects.

items.prompt: Which statement about multiplication is true?

options.text: Multiplication represents equal groups; 3 groups of 4 has 12 objects.

items.explanation: Multiplication counts equal groups: 3 groups of 4 is 4 + 4 + 4 = 12.

items.prompt: Which multiplication sentence matches 3 groups of 4?
Which is NOT a correct multiplication statement?
items.explanation: Multiplication needs equal groups. Mixing different-sized groups without adjusting is wrong.
Three groups of four means three 4s added together: 4 + 4 + 4 = 12.
